about.title: fekauʻaki
about.paragraph1: Ko ʻeni maʻá e tohi faleʻi ʻoku kamata maʻu pē. Ko ia ʻoku toho ʻa e tohi foʻou, tohi ʻa e ngaahi fuʻu kupu ʻe tolu (pe ʻikai ha taha), pea pau ʻe nau maʻu ʻa e miniti ʻe 40 ʻi he fakafoki ʻo e fonema. Ko ia ʻoku haʻu hono ngaahi ʻilo lahi ʻi he ʻaho ʻe 2 ʻi he pongipongi pea faʻoa ʻi ha meʻa. Ko ia ʻoku ʻi aí ʻa e ngaahi peesi ʻe taha teau mā fā, ngaahi langa ʻe ono, pea ʻoku kei nofo ʻa e kupu tohi ko ia ʻi he māhina ʻe taha.
about.paragraph2Before: ʻOku ou ʻilo, he ko au pē ia
about.paragraph2After: . ʻOku ou maʻu ʻa e ADHD, Otisimi, ʻo mahalo ʻoku ʻi ai foki ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kehe ʻoku ʻikai kei fakatotolo. ʻOku ou fie maʻu ha meʻa ʻoku ne mahino ʻeku ʻatamai fakapokapokaʻi kae manavahē fakaʻofoʻofa. Ko e feitu'u ki hono liloʻi ʻo ʻeku ngaahi meʻa kotoa kimuʻa pea ʻosi (pe kamata tohi). Ko e ngaahi vaʻaʻi nounou, ko e ngaahi fakakaukau hafu, ko e ngaahi fehokotaki 'aho 3 ʻi he pongipongi. Kotoa, ʻi ha feitu'u ʻe taha.
about.paragraph3: Ko ia au na'a ku langa ai ʻa e feitu'u ko ʻeni maʻá kitautolu. ʻOku ou ʻamanaki ʻe ʻomai kiate koe ʻa e fiefia tatau mo ia na'a ne ʻomai kiate au ʻi heʻeku langa.
about.paragraph4Before: Ko e taha foki... ʻOku ou tui ki he tekinolosia maʻá e lelei, pea ʻoku ou fehiʻa ki he ngaahi ʻapitanga. Ko ia, ʻe pehē maʻu pē ko e taʻe-ʻapitanga pea TAʻETOTONGI maʻá e ngāue taʻe-fakatau. ʻE lava ke ke kopikopi mo liliu ʻo hangē ko ho'o loto ʻi lalo ʻo e
about.statusValueRest: — ʻoku ʻikai ha fakahoko fakamatala. ʻOku fakaʻehi ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala kotoa ʻi he IndexedDB ʻi ho'o palāoua fakaʻapi. Kapau te ke fakaʻauha ho'o palāoua cache, ʻe ngata ho'o ngāue.
about.feedbackBefore: ʻOku ou kei langa pē ʻa e meʻa ko ʻeni, pea ʻoku ou maʻu ha ngaahi fakakaukau lahi
about.feedbackAfter: . ʻOku ou fiefia ke ongoʻi ko e hā ʻa e ngaahi meʻa lelei, ko e hā ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kovi, pea ko e hā ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ke fie maʻu. ʻOku talitali lelei ʻa e ngaahi ʻiloʻi.

language.title: Lea
language.subtitle: Fili ʻa e lea maʻá e feituʻu fakaʻatamai mo ngaahi tohi ʻo e Ngaahi Lēsoni Tokoniʻanga. Ko e ngaahi fakalea kuo ngata ʻe foki ki he Pēlangi.
language.label: Lea feituʻu fakaʻatamai
language.hint: Ko e ngaahi liliu ʻoku fakaʻaongaʻi fakaokioki pea fakaʻehi ʻi he palāoua ko ʻeni.

editor.title: Fakatohi
editor.subtitle: Ngaahi meʻangāue mo e ngaahi avanoa tohi. ʻOku kei ngāue maʻu pē ʻa e ngaahi hala Markdown (#, >, -, **) tatau ai pē mo ʻeni ngaahi sētingi.
editor.floatingToolbarHint: ʻOku ʻasi ʻi he fakaʻilonga pe kiliki-toʻomataʻu ʻi he founga tohi.
editor.rightClickHint: Fetongi ʻi he vaʻa ʻi he meʻangāue ʻoku ʻamo mo e lisi tuʻunga totonu ʻo e palāoua.
editor.rightClickTooltip: Ngāueʻaki ʻa e lisi tuʻunga totonu ʻo e palāoua ʻi he kiliki-toʻomataʻu kae ʻikai ko e meʻangāue ʻoku ʻamo. ʻE kei ʻasi pē ʻa e meʻangāue ʻi he fakaʻilonga-fili.
editor.inlineTogglesHint: Ngaahi pihi Lahi mo Ataʻata ʻi loto ʻo e meʻangāue ʻoku ʻamo.
editor.inlineTogglesTooltip: Fufū ʻa e ngaahi pihi L mo A mei he meʻangāue ʻoku ʻamo. ʻOku kei ngāue maʻu pē ʻa e ngaahi hala Markdown (**, _).
editor.listDepthHint: Ko e hili ʻe lava ai ʻo nonofo ʻa e ngaahi lisi fakatohu mo e ngaahi fika.
editor.listDepthTooltip: Hikiʻi pe fakasiʻisiʻi ʻa e tapuhā ʻo e nonofo lisi. ʻOku tūtohu ʻi he ngaahi hili ʻe 2 he taimi ni.
editor.templateDefaultsLabel: Ngaahi tuʻunga fakapōtōpōtō ʻo e potuʻi
editor.templateDefaultsHint: Ko e ngaahi faʻahinga fakafotunga kehekehe ki he potuʻi kotoa.
editor.templateDefaultsTooltip: Tuku ʻa e potuʻi kotoa (talanoa, lēsisitaa, tekinikale…) ke fili hono ʻene faʻahinga fakafotunga.

general.comingSoonBody: Maʻumalo mālohi, fakasiʻisiʻi ngāue, ʻilo fakapotoʻi ki, mo e vaʻa ʻoku ʻata ʻi he kamata.

general.startupHint: Ko e hā ʻoku ke mamata ai ʻi ho'o tukuange ʻo e lekōtia.

appearance.accentHint: Ngāueʻaki maʻá e ʻamo ʻi, fakaʻatamamali, sēnolo fakatohi ngāue.

backups.keepHint: Ko e ngaahi fakaʻasi motuʻa ʻoku toʻo ʻotomētiki.

sync.title: Fakahoko
sync.subtitle: Push ho'o ngaahi feituʻu ki ha foloda ʻoku ke fili. Toʻo ki ha foloda Google Drive, Dropbox, pe iCloud ke fakahoko ʻi he ngaahi misini.
sync.unsupportedTitle: ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻi he palāoua ko ʻeni
sync.unsupportedBody: ʻOku fie maʻu ʻe he fakahoko foloda ʻa e API Maʻu Fakaʻilonga Faile, ʻoku maʻu ʻi Chrome, Edge, mo e ngaahi palāoua kehe Chromium ʻi he laulau. Fetongi ki ha palāoua ʻoku lagolagoʻi ke ngāueʻaki.
sync.folderHint: Ko e fakahoko kotoa ʻoku tohi ai ha Markdown .zip ki he feituʻu kotoa ʻi heni, ʻoku tauhi ʻa e 5 kimui mo ha latest.zip. Ko e Fakahoko ko ha meʻa kehekehe mei he Tauhi.
sync.noFolder: ʻOku ʻikai ha foloda kuo hono
sync.intervalHint: Ko e tuʻo ngata e fakahoko ʻotomētiki ʻo e ngaahi feituʻu ʻi he taimi ʻoku tuke ai ʻa e lekōtia pea kuo hono ʻa e foloda. ʻE lava ʻe he feituʻu kotoa ke liliu ʻa e tuʻunga totonu ko ʻeni.
sync.pushOnlyHint: Push pē he taimi ni — ʻoku tohi ai ho'o fakamatala fakaʻapi ki he foloda. Ko e pull ngaahi liliu ʻoku haʻu.
sync.reconnectHint: Kuo taʻofi ʻa e fakahoko — ʻoku fie maʻu ʻe he palāoua ʻa e fakangofua foloda maʻá e taimi ko ʻeni. Hono foʻou ke hokohoko ʻa e fakahoko ʻaki e nima mo ʻotomētiki.

members.title: Ngaahi mēmipa
members.subtitle: Ko e ngaahi tohi fakataha mo sivisivi ʻoku maʻu ke hū ki he feituʻu ko ʻeni.
members.comingSoonBody: Fakaʻeke ngāue fakataha, puleʻi ngaahi lakanga, mo e sivisivi ngaahi liliu. ʻOku haʻu mo e fakahoko ʻao.
members.inviteHint: Te mau tuku atu ha hono ke nau hū ki he feituʻu ko ʻeni.

backups.title: Tauhi
backups.subtitle: Fakaʻasi ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni ko ha .zip ʻe lava ke tikiake, tauhi, mo toe fokotuʻu.
backups.retentionHint: ʻOku tauhi ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻasi {{count}} foʻou — ko e ngaahi motuʻa ʻoku toʻo ʻotomētiki.
backups.empty: ʻOku ʻikai ha ngaahi fakaʻasi — fakatupu ha taha ʻaki e + fakaʻasi he taimi ni.
backups.deleteConfirm: Fakaʻauha ʻa e fakaʻasi ko ʻeni? ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fokotuʻu.
backups.restoreUnavailable: Na'e ngaohi ʻa e fakaʻasi ko ʻeni kimuʻa ʻi he lagolagoʻi ʻo e toe fokotuʻu — ʻe lava pē ke tikiake.
backups.restoreDialogTitle: Toe fokotuʻu ʻa e fakaʻasi ko ʻeni?
backups.restoreDialogBody: Ko e ngaahi meʻa he taimi ni ʻo e feituʻu ko ʻeni ʻe fakafoki ki he fakaʻasi. Ko ha fakaʻasi ʻo e tuʻunga he taimi ni ʻe fakaʻehi muʻa, ko ia ʻe lava ke ke toe fakaʻauha ʻa e toe fokotuʻu ko ʻeni.
backups.restored: Kuo toe fokotuʻu ʻa e fakaʻasi.
backups.fileRestoreTitle: ʻOku toe fokotuʻu mei ha .zip kuo tikiake?
backups.fileRestoreBody: Maʻu mai ʻo e ala ʻi Ngaahi Sētingi Kotoa → Tukuange / Maʻu mai — ʻe toe haʻu ko e feituʻu foʻou, mo e feituʻu ko ʻeni ʻoku ʻikai suia.

sync.title: Fakahoko
sync.subtitle: Push ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni ki he foloda kuo hono, ʻaki e nima pe ʻi ha ʻokosi. Ko e Fakahoko ko ha meʻa kehekehe mei he Tauhi.
sync.folderHint: Hono ha foloda ʻi Ngaahi Sētingi Kotoa → Fakahoko. Ko e foloda tatau ʻoku ngāueʻaki maʻá e ngaahi feituʻu kotoa.
sync.intervalHint: Ko e tuʻo ngata e fakahoko ʻotomētiki ʻo e feituʻu ko ʻeni. Fili Tuʻunga totonu ke muimui ki he sētingi fakahoko ʻotomētiki laulahi.
sync.syncNow: Fakahoko ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni

danger.title: Feituʻu fakatu'utāmaki
danger.subtitle: Ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku ʻikai toe fokotuʻuʻi. Lau ʻo taau ʻo ke hokohoko.
danger.deleteCardTitle: Fakaʻauha ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni
danger.deleteCardBody: ʻOku toʻo maʻu pē ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni fakaʻatoa mo e ngaahi tohi, vaʻa, ngaahi manatua Brain space, ngaahi fakamatala, fakamo'oni, mo e ngaahi hono. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fokotuʻu.
danger.deleteButton: Fakaʻauha ʻa e feituʻu ko ʻeni
danger.dialogBody: ʻOku toʻo maʻu pē ʻa e feituʻu mo e ngaahi meʻa ʻi ai kotoa. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fokotuʻu.
